_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154423 (art), 154641-154650 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described.
name: Mobile Anti-Air
_alias_note: No "aa" or "anti-air" alias. Both are generic: "Anti-Air Missile" is an attack helicopter secondary, so those forms would pull unrelated lines onto this page.

options.name: Multi-Purpose
options.description: A shell designed to combat aircraft. Ineffective against armored ground vehicles.
options.title: Multi-Purpose AA Shell

options.name: High-Velocity
options.title: High Velocity AA Shell
options.description: A quick-firing round effective against fast-moving and lightly armored aircraft. Ineffective against armored ground vehicles.

options.name: Anti-Armor
options.description: A slow-firing shell with high damage against armored targets. Most effective against slow-moving aircraft. Ineffective against armored ground vehicles.
options.title: Anti-Armor AA Shell

options.name: Lock-Guided
options.description: A surface-to-air missile designed to enage fast moving aircraft. Requires lock-on before launch, after which missiles will self-guide to the target unless intercepted by countermeasures. Designated targets can be locked on at greater range and lose below-radar protection.
options.title: Lock-Guided AA Missile

options.name: Laser-Guided
options.title: Laser-Guided AA Missile
options.description: A highly maneuverable laser-guided surface-to-air missile. Allows proficient users to bypass countermeasures. Guides towards the point of aim.

options.name: High-Velocity
options.description: A high velocity surface-to-air missile for enaging larger aircraft. Has limited guidance towards the point of aim. Sacrifices maneuverability for speed.
options.title: High Velocity AA Missile

options.name: Thermal-Blocking
options.title: Thermal-Blocking Smoke
options.description: Discharges a cloud of thermal smoke that obscures the vehicle. Disrupts the guidance systems of incoming lock-on missiles, blocks spotting, and deals moderate damage to enemy infantry inside the smoke radius.

options.name: Systems Upgrade
options.description: Faster cooldowns enabled on all equipment and increased radar range.

options.name: Optimized Handling
options.description: Improves vehicle turning rate and aiming speed.

options.name: Enhanced Loading
options.description: Increases reload speed on both primary and secondary weapons. System deactivates when vehicle countermeasures are used.
options.title: Enhanced Loading Systems

options.name: Targeting Jammer
options.description: Slows the enemy's ability to acquire lock-on, clears the vehicle's spotted marker sooner, and reduces its heat signature in thermal imaging.
